turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have about twenty minutes, and I'd like to know who decided on the zero.
I'm not here to be thanked, Hale. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
You obviously put the hours in with him. His reading level is years ahead of the class.
Don't manage me, Hale. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
You're the kind of parent I wish every kid had.
Save it, Hale. I've asked you twice who decided on the zero, and nobody called me before it went in.
So I'd love your blessing to handle this my way. I trust your judgment, and I hope you'll trust mine.
You don't get a blessing for a plan I haven't heard. What is "your way", Hale, and what do you have that I can check?
